hero.lead: Building the path from interfaces to systems: typed backends, relational storage, and pipelines that move data with intent.
hero.hint: Move the cursor — every node is a unit of computation

identity.statement: Software is an instrument. Every language, schema and abstraction is chosen for its measurable contribution to an objective — never by habit or taste.

principles.title: Instrumental rationality
principles.body: Means are evaluated against ends. What does not move the objective is removed.

principles.title: Engineering before ornament
principles.body: Specify, measure, then build. Form is a consequence of constraints.

principles.title: Data as ground truth
principles.body: Decisions are traced back to data. A model is only as reliable as its inputs.

principles.title: Flat control flow
principles.body: Many small functions, at most two levels of nesting, explicit contracts between them.

timeline.title: Dual-thread execution
timeline.subtitle: Two concurrent processes sharing one clock. Neither blocks the other.

threadA.label: Industry
threadA.summary: Professional activity since 23/02/2022: internship, apprenticeship, now a permanent role, fully remote. Frontend and full-stack development on a proprietary framework, now migrating to Angular with AI-assisted code generation. A deliberate descent through the stack: from user interfaces to systems programming and data management.

interface.title: Interface layer
interface.body: Web interfaces, server-side rendering, first contact with relational schemas; today a proprietary framework migrating to Angular and TypeScript.

systems.title: Systems layer
systems.body: Memory ownership, deterministic performance, low-level control with Rust and C.

data.title: Data layer
data.body: Relational modeling on PostgreSQL, reproducible environments with Docker.

threadB.label: Academic
threadB.summary: Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering at the University of Bologna, in progress part-time. First and only degree, executed in parallel with full-time work.

foundations.title: Formal foundations
foundations.body: Mathematical, physical and circuit models underlying computation.

computing.title: Computing systems
computing.body: Programming, digital logic, hardware architectures, operating systems.

information.title: Information systems
information.body: Databases, computer networks, web technologies, statistical reasoning on data.

projects.title: Systems & architecture
projects.subtitle: Projects built as bridges toward Data Engineering.

discipline.title: Deliberate optimization
discipline.subtitle: The same method applied outside the terminal: measure, program, iterate.

Targets: jump, sprint and raw strength; aesthetics is a side effect.
